existingIdSource.instruction: Existing id/key/source values copied unchanged for mapping only. No new permanent IDs assigned and no audit statuses copied.

methodology: Union of working-tree tracked/untracked changes and incoming commit changes versus c7b56eff; canonical repository-relative paths.
SHA256 hashes cover exact inspected file bytes: disk bytes for working-tree and git object bytes for incoming/baseline. CRLF/LF differences can change hashes independently of semantics.

Export and named top-level function syntax parsed using installed TypeScript; anonymous callbacks, nested functions, object methods and computed re-export targets are outside named-function counts. HTTP methods are exported route handlers.
Environment names only, obtained from source references, checked-in .env.example assignment names and provider config metadata. No local environment files or secret values were read.
Generated docs/final-audit artifacts and finalaudit.md are excluded from product/source candidates. Tests and support documentation are labeled separately.
This artifact records incremental discovery, not executed workflow coverage or approval. Owner merges may change current byte hashes after this snapshot.

Git object hashes and baseline existence independently validated with git cat-file blob, including dynamic [provider] paths. Incoming added environment references are distinguished from globally new names using baseline source/template names.
